focus: Local AI platform for building and running models across customer-owned devices
problem: Organizations want private AI that runs on their own devices rather than cloud APIs.
products: webAI Navigator | webAI distributed inference | webAI models / ColVec
differentiator: Distributed on-device inference across customers' own hardware with a $2.5B valuation.

name: WEKA
last_round: Series E, $140M, May 2024, led by Valor Equity Partners ($1.6B post-money)
focus: Software-defined data and memory infrastructure for AI training and inference
problem: GPUs sit idle waiting on data, and limited GPU memory inflates inference latency and cost.
products: NeuralMesh | Augmented Memory Grid | WEKApod | NeuralMesh Axon | WARRP (WEKA AI RAG Reference Platform)
differentiator: Memory-tier approach to inference: NVMe-backed KV-cache grid integrated with NVIDIA AI factory stacks.

name: Wind River
status_detail: Acquired by Aptiv from TPG, closed Dec 23, 2022 (~$3.5B)
focus: Embedded and edge software: VxWorks, Linux and cloud-native edge platform.
problem: Mission-critical embedded and edge systems need safe, certified software to run modern AI workloads.
products: VxWorks | Wind River Studio | Wind River Linux / eLxr Pro
differentiator: Decades of safety-certified embedded OS applied to edge AI.

name: Windsurf
status_detail: Remaining business acquired by Cognition (Jul 2025); CEO and co-founders joined Google in $2.4B licensing deal
last_round: Acquired by Cognition, Jul 2025, terms undisclosed
focus: AI-native coding IDE and assistant (formerly Codeium) now part of Cognition.
problem: Enterprises want AI coding assistance without sending proprietary source code to third-party clouds.
products: Windsurf Editor | Windsurf Enterprise (self-hosted/hybrid) | Devin Desktop
differentiator: Early to offer self-hosted and FedRAMP High AI coding assistant.

name: WITINMEM
last_round: Series B3 (B-III), ~$29M, Jan 2023, incl. SDIC Venture Capital
focus: Analog compute-in-memory (flash) AI chips for wearables, hearables and IoT
problem: Always-on AI in earbuds and wearables drains batteries when data shuttles between memory and processor.
products: WTM2101 | WTM8 series | WTM2101 development kit and toolchain
differentiator: Among the first to mass-produce analog compute-in-flash AI chips for consumer devices.

name: World Wide Technology
focus: Technology integration and supply chain, including on-prem and sovereign AI factory builds
problem: Enterprises and governments struggle to design, validate and deploy multi-vendor private AI infrastructure.
products: AI Proving Ground | AI Factory / NVIDIA AI factory practice | Advanced Technology Center (ATC)
differentiator: Scale integrator with NVIDIA 2026 partner awards and multi-vendor AI validation labs.

name: Writer
last_round: Series C, $200M, Nov 2024, at $1.9B valuation
focus: Full-stack enterprise generative AI platform and Palmyra models
problem: Enterprises need governed AI agents without exposing data to general-purpose model vendors.
products: Palmyra X5 | Palmyra Med / Fin | WRITER AI HQ | Self-hosted Palmyra
differentiator: Own models plus graph-based RAG, deployable in customer environment.

name: Xailient
status_detail: Unconfirmed current activity
focus: Efficient on-device computer vision and face recognition for edge cameras.
problem: Cloud-based vision is costly, slow and privacy-invasive for cameras and low-power devices.
products: Xailient Face Recognition SDK | Xailient Detectum

differentiator: European private-inference stack on sovereign Italian data centres.

name: Xiaomi

differentiator: Deterministic real-time multicore architecture combining I/O, DSP, control and AI in one low-cost chip.

problem: Teams need one unified way to serve many open models on their own servers.
products: Xinference | Xinference Enterprise | Xorbits

name: xpander.ai
last_round: Seed, $7.5M, Aug 2026, led by Pico Venture Partners

last_round: Seed, $15.5M, 2024, led by Lightspeed (unverified)
